input_archive.members: inputs/<id>/input.json and system.sing; results and solver logs also retained

catalog/index.json.contains: input identities, source hashes and sizes, variable blocks, per-equation index names, Boolean degree/term summaries

catalog/*.equations.jsonl.record: one original equation, original source byte_offset and byte_length, line_1_based, equation_id, field_equation, Boolean degree/terms/support where applicable

header: offset0:8 bytes magic N83V2R1 followed by newline
closure/<id>/basis.rows.u64le.record: one immutable inserted row in insertion order; bit c is the F2 coefficient of column c

closure/<id>/operations.jsonl.record: step, source equation ID or prior parent-row ID and zero-based variable, prior xor_basis_rows, inserted_row ID or null for zero

closure/<id>/result.json.contains: input identity, source hash, closure rank, linear row IDs, free variables, all exhaustively checked assignments and whether each satisfies every original equation, optional exact LFD2 certificate or lower bound

first-fall/<id>.json.contains: source identity, rank/witness or prime minor, exact first fall or lower bound; not last fall

status/*.json.contains: actual producer/replay exit codes including limits and errors

replay/*.jsonl.contains: fresh-process replay receipt or preserved failure output; not independent research review

summary.json.contains: all 48 inputs with separate first fall, closure/LFD, regularity fields; missing values are null

manifest.sha256.contains: relative paths and hashes of every raw file except the manifest itself

retention: Append new run IDs and amendments; preserve partial and failed outputs. Never treat an incomplete file as a completed certificate.
